House rules

  • Respect other members. Harassment, hate, bullying, doxxing, and attacks on race, religion or royalty are prohibited.
  • Keep private information and screenshots out of public chats. Avoid unverified rumours, explicit content, gore, scams and gambling.
  • Stay on topic, use the right channels, and ask an admin before posting promotions.
  • Keep banter mutual and stop when asked. Adults should contact minors privately only for community-related reasons.

Report an issue

Send a brief description privately to an FN Squad admin or moderator. Include the channel, message link if available, and approximate time. Redact unrelated names and details from screenshots. Read the reporting privacy notice before sharing evidence.

Open DiscordOther contact options

Moderation & appeals

Moderators may issue a warning or mute, a temporary suspension of 3 to 14 days, or removal. Serious violations may lead to an immediate ban. The first two strikes expire after 90 days without further violations.

Appeal within 14 days. Include the case number if you have one so a different admin can review it.
